newsitem.title: UK: Dalgety shares tumble after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Dalgety shares tumble after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Dalgety Plc dropped in pre-market trading on Wednesday after the food and agribusineess company warned that results in the second half would fall short of its performance in the first half of the year.
The stock was down 48p at 262-1/2 by 0710 GMT in volume of 60,000 shares.
The company also said it would cut its dividend, with a total payout this year expected to be not less than 14.5p compared with 22p a year before.
It said third-quarter profits for petfoods and agriculture had been disappointing and the strength of sterling had continued to affect profits.
